Rina (ML): heads upwe started an A/B with v3-lite-int8 on the /generate-docs route at 03:10 UTC (2% traffic). overall latency and cost look good but we're seeing a small hit to structured_output_validity on the route (about -2.6% absolute).

Marco (Infra): what's the validity metric exactly? schema-parse pass rate or field-level match?

Rina (ML): schema-parse pass rate. baseline=0.922 -> v3-lite-int8=0.896 on that route. samples concentrated on codeblock+tables long-docs.

Priya (Support): any customer-facing errors yet? CS hasn't reported but a couple customers on legal templates could be impacted.

Evan (Product): if templates break it's bad. can we fail-open to non-quant variant for template-heavy traffic?

Rina (ML): not globally yet. propose a route-aware circuit-breaker: fallback variant when route-specific metric regression exceeds thresholds AND the route carries meaningful traffic share. quick pseudo-rule:
```
# route-aware fallback (5m rolling window)
if rolling_delta(route, metric='schema_parse_pass', window=5m) > 0.025 and route_traffic_share(route) > 0.01:
    rollback(route)
elif rolling_delta(global, metric='schema_parse_pass', window=10m) > 0.05:
    global_rollback()
```

Marco (Infra): add hysteresis so tiny oscillations don't flip-flop. maybe require threshold breached for 3 consecutive windows or require a 2x stdev above noise.

Rina (ML): agreed. propose additional condition: require breach for 3/5 windows and absolute loss > 0.015 on route to avoid tiny blips.

Priya (Support): can we add an immediate mitigation: route tag matching known "template-*" clients to prefer baseline until we fix quant kernels for table-format prompts?

Rina (ML): yes we can set route overrides for tagged clients. Marco - is that policy easy to push via rollout-config?

Marco (Infra): yea, we can add a route override that pins specific client-tags to baseline variant. ops-bot can enforce.

ops-bot: anomaly-detector flagged route "/generate-docs" schema_parse deviation: delta=0.026 at 03:22 UTC.

Evan (Product): next steps: (1) implement route-aware circuit-breaker with hysteresis, (2) add tag-based override for template clients, (3) run a focused shadow test on long-doc/table prompts with unquantized kernels and int8 to isolate kernel regression.

Rina (ML): I'm running a head-to-head replay now across 2.3k recorded long-doc requests. early diff shows most failures in the attention-kernel boundary where nested tables exist. attaching quick stats: 
```
replay: 2300 samples
schema_parse_pass: baseline=0.924, v3-lite-int8=0.897 (delta -0.027)
structured_field_mismatch: baseline=0.6% -> v3-lite-int8=1.9%
latency_p95: baseline=450ms -> v3-lite-int8=430ms
```

Marco (Infra): ok I'll wire the circuit-breaker into the rollout pipeline. ops-bot can auto-rollback a route for the cohort if rule triggers (with 10m cooloff and owner notify).

Priya (Support): I'll draft a short CS note asking customers to report template breakages and add a link to the status page if we roll back.

Rina (ML): also suggesting we add a route-specific shadow that sends 100% of template-tagged requests to an int8 shadow pool before next promote. lower blast radius.

Evan (Product): good. please put the rule and ownership into the rollout runbook and schedule a quick postmortem after we collect more replay evidence.

ops-bot: action created: 1768601234-route-aware-hysteresis-gate (assignee: Marco).

Rina (ML): thanks all. will follow up with a short analysis note and candidate kernel fixes. ping me if you want sample IDs.
